changes.text: Extensions: a folder with a manifest and a program in any language, run as a separate process over a one-line JSON protocol with time and output limits.
Extensions tab with search, permission consent on first use and whenever a new version asks for more, on-demand runs and last results.
Built-in extensions: output checksums, workflow lint and build summary. Sample extensions in sh and Python for authors.
Check with extensions on the workflow preview.
Linux launcher (scripts/run-linux.sh) with checks, a self-test, a systemd user service and an applications-menu entry.
Browser check (scripts/browser-check.mjs) that drives the real page in headless Chrome; it runs in CI.
The Ctrl+Shift+F command palette now opens; it was never attached to the page in 0.4.0.
Switching tabs while the window is resized no longer reports an error.
The server listens on the address in HOST (all addresses by default, 127.0.0.1 from the Linux launcher).
Browser-style tabs with every page open by default, pinning, reordering and an Open every tab catalog.
Ctrl+Shift+F command palette covering pages, commands and live settings.
A regex builder beside every search box, with flags, sample text, captures and export.
English, Cantonese and bilingual modes with two funny-level sliders and School mode.
Tools tab: Base64 toolkit, local file and image converter, and a JSON studio with a type generator.
Per-element appearance editor, colour picker with format conversion and contrast checks, and logo choices.
Local personal wording: upload or drop a vocabulary JSON that rewrites any phrase, including failure messages.
Setup wizard, guided tour, offline documentation, this changelog and a completeness page.
Notification centre, action sounds, narration, settings history with restore, and export in nine formats.
Context menu on every element with copy, read aloud, lock, export and appearance options.
Bulk select, export and dismiss in Runs; two-key confirmation for destructive actions.
Front-screen version and updated-at, read from the build or the git checkout.
Run keys use the URL-safe base64 alphabet, so Git Bash on Windows runners can no longer rewrite a key that starts with a slash.
Run a repository's own workflows, rewritten for a safe temporary run, with sealed artifacts in encrypted mode.
The mac command line with assisted GitHub CLI sign-in.
Design canvas covering every surface.
Generated PowerShell steps no longer confuse YAML anchors.

releases.title: Workflow creator and encrypted public builder

changes.text: Build scripts (.bat, .cmd, .ps1, .sh) from any repository on a chosen runner.
Encrypted public builder mode: only ciphertext ever reaches the public repository.
Builds survive app restarts through a journal and reattach to their runs.
Build Docker images on throwaway GitHub Actions repositories and download them.
Temporary repositories are deleted on success and failure, plus a sweeper for leftovers.
